frameworks.dockerfile_template:
FROM ghost:{{version}}-alpine
COPY content /var/lib/ghost/content
RUN rm -f /var/lib/ghost/content/themes/casper && rm -f /var/lib/ghost/content/themes/source
ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV server__host=0.0.0.0
ENV server__port=2368
ENV database__client=sqlite3
ENV database__connection__filename=/var/lib/ghost/content/data/ghost-local.db
ENV database__useNullAsDefault=true
VOLUME /var/lib/ghost/content/data
EXPOSE 2368
